autoContext: CREATION pipeline for a script: outline -> scene cards -> character/location bible -> full script, each stage writing to disk and the next stage reading that file back rather than trusting its own memory of the reply.

intake.prompt: Output directory for this script project (e.g. heist-movie):
Logline — one or two sentences describing the premise:
Genre and tone (e.g. dark comedy heist thriller):

scene_cards.prompt:
OUTLINE:
{outline_doc}

For every numbered beat in the outline, write one scene card as its own Markdown file: {workspace}/scenes/scene-<NN>.md (NN zero-padded to the beat number). Each scene card must contain: a level-1 heading with the scene's slugline (INT./EXT. LOCATION - DAY/NIGHT), a Characters Present list, a Goal line (what the protagonist of the scene wants), a Conflict line (what opposes it), and a 2-4 sentence beat summary matching the outline.

Emit each scene card as its own path-bearing fence. No other commentary outside the fences.

bible.prompt:
OUTLINE:
{outline_doc}

SCENE CARDS:
{scene_cards_text}

From the outline and scene cards above, produce two documents:

1. {workspace}/characters.md — one section per named character appearing in the scene cards, each with: full name, one-line role (protagonist/antagonist/supporting), physical/voice description, motivation, and the scene numbers they appear in.
2. {workspace}/locations.md — one section per distinct location named in the scene cards' subheadings, each with: a short physical description and the scene numbers set there.

Do not invent characters or locations not already present in the scene cards. Emit each as its own path-bearing fence. No other commentary outside the fences.
